gary_2026_11_05_startup_mixer.summary: Gary's Guide: NYC Tech &Startup Mixer - brought to you by Startup+ We're putting founders, engineers, investors, recruiters, freelancers, & mentors in the same room for a night of straightup networking. No panels, no speeches-just real conversations. If you're testing an idea, raising cash, or hiring your first dev, this is the place to be. Newsletter (exclusive entry & event drops): https://newsletter.startupplus.club Sponsorship / press: email - contact@startupplus.club Volunteer (Complimentary Ticket): email - contact@startupplus.club Why swing by? Meet 100+ builders & backers in one go Swap stories, get quick feedback, share lessons learned Spot future cofounders, investors, customers-maybe all three What's the setup? We've got a dedicated space, & name tags at the door Flash a business card or a LinkedIn QR-whatever works Dress code? Businesscasual. Jeans totally fine. A quick word on Startup+ We kicked this off in 2021, in the middle of the pandemic, because Zoom mixers just weren't cutting it. Fastforward: 25k members, 75+ mixers, 12 pitch nights, & 6000 folks through the doors. We keep it simple-connect good people & let the magic happen. Headsup: capacity is capped. Only confirmed Luma RSVPs are admitted at the door. Walkins = no go. Fine print : By joining, you agree that photos/video taken may be used in future Startup+ promos. Also, you agree that the contact info collected will be used to send future event invites & promotions via newsletter/other event platforms. See you IRL!!!

gary_2026_11_06_app_after_dark_mobile_ap.title: App After Dark: Mobile App Hackathon
gary_2026_11_06_app_after_dark_mobile_ap.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_11_06_app_after_dark_mobile_ap.summary: Gary's Guide: What's happening? Bilt.me is teaming up with The AI Collective, Veris.ai & Mobbin to host Mobile App Hackathon Night in New York: an evening for getting a real mobile app out of your head & onto your phone, with AI. A friendly hackathon where the only rule is to ship something by the end of the night. Most app ideas never leave the Notes app. Tonight yours does. No code needed. Bring a fresh idea or something you've already started. Describe what you want in plain language, keep refining it, & leave with an app running on your phone that you can show people. All you need is a laptop & the willingness to call something done. You'll be hacking alongside founders, designers, coders & people with too many ideas in their Notes app. Come solo or bring a friend, & we'll help you find teammates. Why come? Build your app with Bilt.me & meet the people building with AI in New York. Plus a Mobbin discount for everyone who comes. Pizza on us Format Teams of one or two. A quick kickoff, then three hours of heads-down hacking with a clear finish line: get it working on your phone. We wrap with demos, so everyone sees what got shipped. What to expect A short intro to building with Bilt.me Time to hack, test on your phone & ask questions Friendly feedback from the room Demos at the end Good conversations & new people to build with Who is it for? Anyone who wants to stop thinking about an app & start shipping one: aspiring founders, designers, creatives, AI-curious builders, & people who have never written code. What to bring? A laptop Your phone An idea, or the app you've already started Co-hosted with The AI Collective The AI Collective is a global non-profit building the human layer for the AI era. We unite 200,000+ leaders, builders, & stakeholders across 100+ forums worldwide to democratize the frontier, build trust, & coordinate how society navigates the rapid acceleration of technological progress. Our partners Veris.ai is supporting the night as a partner. Veris AI builds simulated environments where companies train & test AI agents before putting them into real use. Think of it as a practice arena that lets enterprise AI agents make mistakes safely before they touch real customers or systems. Mobbin is the design reference library behind a lot of the apps you love: real screens & flows from the best apps out there, all in one place. Tonight it's your shortcut to great design. Find a screen you love on Mobbin, screenshot it, & drop it into Bilt as the starting point for your app. Everyone who comes gets a Mobbin discount code on the night. Seats are limited & we read every application. About Bilt.me Bilt turns a plain-language idea into a real native mobile app, with the frontend, database & login all built for you, ready to test on your phone & publish to the App Store & Google Play. When: Friday 6th November 2026 Time: 6pm to 9pm Where: New York, venue to be announced. We'll share the location with approved guests. Entry: Free Bilt.me credits: included, sponsored Hosted by Bilt.me in collaboration with The AI Collective (aicollective.com), Veris.ai & Mobbin (mobbin.com) We take pictures during this event & will use those pictures for marketing. If you don't wish to be photographed, let us know in advance & we can accommodate. Link to Bilt privacy policy: bilt.me/privacy

jc_culture_10003576_2026_11_11_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. You can also find baked goods, candles, personal care products, and more. You can even take advantage of convenient services like on-site knife sharpening while you shop. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_42883_2026_11_18_jodeci_jerse.summary: Get ready to experience an unforgettable night as Jodeci takes the stage for their highly anticipated concert, “”Jodeci – Jersey City,”” at the iconic Landmark Loews Theatre. Nestled in the heart of Jersey City, this historic venue boasts a stunning atmosphere that perfectly complements the smooth R&B vibes of the legendary group. With its grand architecture and intimate setting, the Loews Theatre is the ideal backdrop for an evening filled with soulful melodies and nostalgic hits. Join fellow fans for a night of electrifying performances that will have you singing along and dancing in your seat. The energy will be palpable as Jodeci delivers their timeless classics and new favorites, making this a must-see event for R&B lovers. Don’t miss out on this chance to witness music history in the making—secure your spot now and be part of the magic at Jodeci – Jersey City!
